snippet.title: Gunstoppable - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed multiplies damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapons and bend time to crush hordes of robots and evil billionaires! The faster you move, the harder you hit. Dodge bullet-hell barrages with wild movement tech and perfectly timed parries.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3724710/Gunstoppable/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
